Commentary.Commentary: 50 minutes left into the session then. Almost say, around 12-13 overs. Australia will aim to get around 50-60 by Tea. Stay tuned.
For Australia, Starc, Hazlewood and Bird finished with 3 wickets apiece but the latter two were looking more threatening. Starc did not quite look consistently menacing.

Sarfraz and Amir batted well today, before a beauty from Bird got the latter. Sarfraz stayed unbeaten on 59 and really, that 54-run stand for the 9th wicket has given some respectability to the total. Just 4 batsmen made it to double figures.

Surprise, surprise. AUSTRALIA WILL BAT AGAIN. Perhaps the fact that Pakistan batted for an hour forced Smith into the decision. They have a sizeable lead, so maybe they will aim to bat for around 30-40 overs and declare before the night session.

OUT! Rahat Ali is gone. Landed outside off, fuller in length, Sarfraz drives it towards mid off and sets off for a single. Rahat responds but then Sarfraz sees that David Warner is onto the ball in a flash to his left. Sends Rahat back. Ali takes a while to turn and does not dive but just slides his bat in. The ball hits the stumps and ricochets towards fine leg and now the batsmen take the overthrow. Australia appeal for the run out and it is referred upstairs. From one angle, it seems that when the ball hits the stumps, Rahat's bat is in the air but comes down when the bails are dislodged. However, from another angle, it looks like the bails are off when the bat is in the air. AUSTRALIA GET A LEAD OF 287.
DIRECT HIT! Is Rahat in trouble? Referred upstairs...
FOUR! What a shot. Short and outside off, Sarfraz gets on top of the bounce and cuts it behind point to the third man fence.
Landed outside off, slapped to sweeper cover.
Another sweep, this time straight to deep backward square leg. Does not run.

DROPPED, FOUR! Tough chance but perhaps Maddinson did not take a start at all. Full and outside off, Sarfraz gets down and sweeps it over mid-wicket but miscues it. Nic Maddinson who is not right at the boundary, takes a while to get going and in the process ends up being away from the ball. He then tries to dive back and catch it bu the ball bursts through his finger and reaches the ropes.
Short and wide outside off, slashed down to third man. Won't take that single so early in the over.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
10th Test Fifty for Sarfraz, first against Australia.

Goes back and works it through square leg for a couple more. That brings up his half century. He continues to show why he has been one of the best keeper-batsmen at number 7 in the last couple of years.
Shorter around off, defended back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, swept through backward square leg for another couple. Moves to 48.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full on middle and off, Sarfraz gets down and sweeps it through mid-wicket. David Warner gives it a good chase and dives to his left from deep square leg to save the boundary. Two runs taken.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Dropped short, pulled through mid-wicket for a single. Now he runs.
Comes down the track and pushes it to long on. Does not run in spite of this being the 4th ball.
Outside off, pretty wide, Ahmed slashes but misses.
Full and outside off, Sarfraz bends down and literally SWEEPS it towards deep mid-wicket. Does not take the single.
On a good length around off, watchfully defended.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Full and outside off, Rahat looks to defend but misses and is hit on the pads. Lyon appeals but Ian Gould smiles and shakes his head. Smith asks Lyon about the review but the bowler himself says that it was spinning down the leg side.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Comes down the track again and drives it to long off. Does not take the single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and outside off, Sarfraz jumps down the track and drives it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Short and outside off, Rahat cuts it behind point for a boundary!
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
RAHAT ALI is the last man in.

OUT! Caught behind! The decision is overturned. Wow. That is not a wicket for the bowler. But for the keeper. Take a bow, Wade. Your eyes and ears are extremely sharp. What a review. On a good length around leg and middle, Amir looks to defend but the ball comes in, cuts him into half. Wade collects and straightaway throws it in the air in celebration. Bird appeals but the umpire shakes his head. The bowler is also not sure about the review and Smith asks his keeper who convinces him to go for it. Hot Spot detects a tiny mark just below the glove and the third umpire is happy with that. Snickometer also shows a deflection. Amir is disappointed but he has got to go. The 54-run stand is broken. Good fight.
Smith takes a review for a caught behind. Wade looks confident. Jackson Bird is not that confident.
Goes back and defends.
Stays back and defends.

Straightaway induces movement. On a good length outside off, Sarfraz pushes inside the line, the ball moves in, takes the inside edge and goes past the leg stump. Hazlewood puts in a good diving effort at the fine leg fence to save the boundary. Three runs taken.
JACKSON BIRD comes on as well.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full on middle and off, blocked back to the bowler.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and outside leg, Mohammad lunges to block but misses and is hit on the pads. A mild LBW appeal from the Aussies.
Similar ball, another watchful defense.
Full and around middle and leg, Amir stretches forward to defend.
It has taken Smith just 6 overs to go to spin this afternoon. NATHAN LYON comes on to bowl.
A bouncer to end the over, Ahmed ducks.
50-RUN STAND COMES UP!
FOUR! That is a good shot. Australia are perhaps overdoing the short stuff now. Landed outside off, Sarfraz stands tall and slams it behind point for a boundary. Nice fightback.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Back of a length on middle, Mohammad tucks it through square leg for a single.
Short ball outside off, steep bounce, Amir rises with that and pushes it towards gully.
Landed outside off, punched through the covers for a couple.
Outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
A bouncer on middle, Amir ducks.
Excellent stop. Amir punches this through the covers but Nathan Lyon dives to his left from point and stops it. The crowd is at it again, cheering for its local lad. Lyon smiles.
On middle and leg, pushed towards the bowler.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Full and outside off, Amir looks to drive but misses.
That is a good shot. Back of a length, around off, MA punches it behind point. Josh Hazlewood gives it a chase from point perhaps and slides near the boundary to stop the ball. Three runs taken.
Full and outside off, Mohammad drives it through the covers for a couple.
FOUR! Comes over the wicket, goes for the fast yorker, but ends up bowling a full toss on the pads. Amir tickles it to the fine leg fence.
That is short and around off, Amir punches it on the bounce through the slip cordon but Peter Handscomb at gully dives to his right and stops the ball. Brilliant.
Outside off, worked through square leg for a single.
That is a sharp ball, short and outside off, rises sharply, Sarfraz is caught by surprise and looks to fend at it. The ball hits the top part of the bat and drops down to the leg side.
Outside off, played straight to point.
Again, goes back and punches it towards cover.
On a good length, around middle, Amir defends solidly. He has been excellently resilient amidst all the rumble.
Good batting. Leans into the shot and pushes the ball towards cover for a single to bring up PAKISTAN'S 100.
A bouncer, around off and middle, Sarfraz ducks.
Outside off, short in length, slapped straight to gully.
A bouncer around middle and leg, MA ducks.
Back of a length around off, pushed towards gully.
Outside off, pushed towards point.
A sharp bouncer, around middle and leg, Mohammad ducks and then sways away.
Bowls a bouncer, around leg, Amir ducks.
Interesting. Starc straightaway coming around the wicket to Amir.
On a good length around middle and off, Sarfraz punches it through the covers for a single. So he is happy to rotate the strike.
MITCHELL STARC to bowl from the other end.
Stays back in his crease and blocks.
A bouncer around middle and leg, Mohammad ducks.
Outside off, played straight to point.
Extra bounce. On a good length around off, angling away, Amir looks to just push it through the off side, half-heartedly and is beaten as the ball bounces more.
On a length around middle and off, worked through square leg for a single.
Full and outside off, defended back to the bowler.

The players are out in the middle amidst bright sunshine. No rain as of now but there is forecast for some later in the evening. It will be JOSH HAZLEWOOD to start proceedings to Sarfraz. Here we go...

Pakistan will have one eye on the weather, but they cannot be batting according to that. They just need to play normal cricket, bat well in the second innings and try and enforce a draw. Before that, if the last 2 wickets can add another 50-60 runs, that could be a boost as well.

Australia had a perfect outing with the ball last night. They might not have been happy with the score they posted, having been 323/3 at one stage but that final session has definitely swung the game their way. Early days still, but from here, it looks like only one team can win this game.

At 97/8, and 332 runs behind, Pakistan have nothing much to look forward to. They have only one motto - bat and bat and bat and try and save the follow-on first. That need not necessarily be by scoring those many runs, but if they manage to keep Australia on the field for more than an hour, then Smith might just want to give his bowlers a rest. But then, the forecast for the weekend is a worry with thunderstorms being predicted.

It was total mayhem at the 'G as the game sprung to life, especially under lights. 15 wickets fell in 83.1 overs for just 238 runs. The visitors slipped from a bad position to a worse one as they had a horror final session. The pink ball spelt doom for them as they lost 7/24 in 14.4 overs. Australia all look set to wrap the innings up this afternoon and enforce a follow-on, unless their opposition fights back strongly. Hello and a warm welcome to the THIRD DAY of the OPENING TEST between AUSTRALIA AND PAKISTAN at the 'Gabba.
... DAY 3, SESSION 1 ...

In all likelihood the hosts will try to bowl them out as soon as possible to impose a follow-on on the visitors. Pakistan on the other hand will try to reduce the deficit to as less as possible in order to stay in the game. Lets see how it toils up tomorrow. Join us at 0830 IST for the 3rd day's play. Till then, take care.

The hosts started off in a shaky manner with Smith being dropped early on but he failed to make the most of it and fell soon. After that, the wickets started falling from one end but Handscomb stayed on the other end to get to his maiden Test hundred. A 49-run partnership for the last wicket saw them post a total of 429.

An excellent day on the field for the Aussies where they have come really strong with the ball against the Pakistani batsmen. Starc and Hazlewood both started off brilliantly as they got three wickets each. None of the batsmen from the visiting team looked in good nick as they all fell prey to some tight bowling outside off. Jackson Bird also chipped in with two important wickets.
Once again Bird angles it in which Amir keeps out to end the day's play safely. THAT'S STUMPS ON DAY 2!
Angling into the batsman from around the wicket, defended from the stance.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Amir looks to punch it off the back foot but misses the ball completely.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Length delivery around off, defended with a straight bat.
Outside off, left alone.

Chance gone! Lyon flights it up nicely drawing Ahmed forward. Sarfraz obliges and charges down and swings the bat wildly. He misses it completely and the ball spins in with bounce. Gets over the top of the stumps. Wade also fails to collect it and the stumping chance goes begging.
Spinning into the pads, Ahmed clips it through forward square leg for a couple.
FOUR! This time he choses a more delicate route. Flighted around off, Ahmed paddles it fine and gets back-to-back boundary.
FOUR! Swept away! Tossed up on off, Ahmed sweeps it uppishly through backward square leg for a boundary. Attacking mode on!
Outside off, Amir leans into the shot and drives it through widish mid off. The mid off fielder cuts it out and keeps it down to a single.
Tossed up around off, defended from within the crease.
Length delivery outside off, played to point.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Length delivery outside off, tapped back to the bowler. Bird collects it and aims a throw at the striker's end as Sarfraz comes out to defend. He hits the woodwork but Ahmed is back in his crease. He looks for an overthrow but is send back by Amir.
On the thigh pad, Amir nudges it fine on the leg side for a single.
Length delivery, punched of the back foot to off side.
Angling away, placed to point for a single.
JACKSON BIRD comes on to bowl.
Served around off, Amir leans ahead and defends it with a straight bat.
From over the wicket, served outside off, spinning in, Amir prods forward and blocks.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Served outside off, pushed to covers for a quick single.
Tossed up fuller on the stumps, swept away on the leg side for no run as it hit short leg.
Tossed up outside off, Sarfraz  charges down and looks to whip it but misses it completely and is rapped up on the pads.
Full and wide outside off, Amir goes for an expansive drive but doesn't make any contact. Eludes an outside edge by just!
Short and angling down leg, Amir ducks as the ball sails over him.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
On the pads, tucked away behind square on the leg side for three runs.
Full outside off, Ahmed goes for a drive gets an outside edge once again but falls short of the man at gully. Handscomb, present there dives to his left and saves a certain boundary.

FOUR! Edged but through! Length delivery outside off, angling away, Sarfraz looks to play it with soft hands on the off side but gets an outside edge and the ball goes through the gap between the third slip and the gully for a boundary.

Full and around off, Amir goes to push it but he totally misses the line of the ball. The ball misses the outside edge and the ball goes straight into the hands of Wade who dislodges the bails really quickly. A loud appeal for both stumping and a catch is denied by the umpire.
Straight and on the middle, Amir pushes it back to the bowler.
Pitched up, Amir leans forward to defend it and the ball tickles away to Lyon.

Pitched outside off, Sarfraz goes for a sweep and he totally misses the ball. There is a loud appeal from Lyon which is denied by the umpire. Impact was way outside off and Lyon has a smile on his face after that appeal.
Pitched up and Ahmed pushes it back to the bowler.
Pitched on the stumps, Sarfraz flicks it towards square leg for a couple.
The batsman has done well to keep that yorker at bay.
Bouncer! Amir gets down and lets it sail through!
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball.
Full on the pads, driven to mid on.
FOUR! Helped on its way! Short ball outside off, Amir upper cuts it over the slip cordon for a boundary. Nicely done!
Full on middle and off, defended with a straight bat.
The batsman drives this through the covers. One run added to the total.
Length delivery outside off, tapped to point.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball.
Full outside off, Amir drives it on the up. Lyon dives to his right and does well to stop it.
Served outside off, worked to point again.
Outside off, dabbed to the slip cordon.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Angling into the pads, clipped to mid-wicket for a single.
Banged in short, Amir gets down in time.
Back of a length delivery, Amir looks to defend but the ball evades the outside edge of his bat.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
MOHAMMAD AMIR is the next man in.

OUT! Now, Starc completes his 3-fer! Back of a length outside off, Shah guides it straight into the hands of Khawaja at third slip. He is not going to let anything slip through his hands today, takes the third catch of the innings. It looked like a catch practice session. Yasir Shah has to walk back. Pakistan with 2 wickets in hand!
Length delivery outside off, pushed to covers with soft hands for a quick single.
YASIR SHAH has walked in!

OUT! Hazlewood completes his 3-fer! Riaz has to depart! On a length around off and angling in, Riaz looks to play it on the leg side but goes off the top of the bat in the air and in the hands of Hazlewood. He just lofts the ball in the air in delight! Pakistan are 7 down for 66!
Length delivery angling in, shapes away a touch, Ahmed looks to defend it but gets off the outer half of his bat and gets it to point. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Length delivery outside off, punched through covers for a single.
Full on the stumps, driven to mid on.
Outside off and on a length, played with soft hands to point for a single.
JOSH HAZLEWOOD replaces Bird!
On the pads, once again Riaz looks to glance it but fails and gets hit on the pads.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man.
Straying on the pads, Riaz looks to tuck it but misses and gets hit on the thigh pad.

Length delivery, angling away, this time Ahmed punches it through the gap in covers. Maddinson gives it a chase and saves the ball from reaching the rope. Warner backs him up nicely and they manage to keep it down to three.
Short delivery, angling away, Ahmed looks to get on top of it and slash it through point but misses.
Full and angling across, Ahmed guides it towards backward point with soft hands.
Length delivery, angling in, defended from within the crease.
Banged in short outside off, Riaz ducks but the ball doesn't bounces as much as he expects but still manages to evade the ball.
Pitched up delivery on off, Riaz looks to drive it but gets off the inside half of his bat to mid on.
Outside off, this time Riaz defends with conviction on the off side.
Play and a miss! Full outside off, Riaz gets tired of defending and goes for a drive but misses it completely.
Full outside off, swinging away, Riaz looks to defend but gets beaten by the away movement.
Starc ends the over with a bouncer. Ahmed sits down and lets it sail through.
Once again Sarfraz places the ball in the gap through covers and pick up a couple.
Banged in short, Ahmed ducks under it.
Shortish delivery, Ahmed gets on the top of the bounce and taps it through cover-point. Warner gives it a chase and keeps it down to two.
Length delivery, played to point.
Short and angling away, Ahmed flashes his bat hard but misses the ball by a margin.
The Aussies are having some issues with the ball and the umpires have a look at it. The ball fails to pass the 8-shaped gauge test and it has been changed.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full delivery on the stumps, driven straight back.
WAHAB RIAZ replaces Aslam.

OUT! Bird is joining the party now! Finally, Aslam is put out of his misery! Angling down leg, Aslam gets across and looks to glance it. Gets a faint edge in the process and Wade behind the stumps does no mistake whatsoever. Now all the pacers have picked up a couple of wickets apiece. Aussie pacers have struck gold with this pink ball under the lights. Now the tail remains!
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Outside off, defended with a straight bat.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat
Short and angling away from Sarfraz, he withdraws his bat at the last moment.
Short delivery outside off, Aslam does really well as he guides it into the ground for a single through the slip cordon.

Angling into the batsman, Ahmed looks to play it on the leg side but gets squared up by the away movement. The ball catches the leading edge and goes towards covers, fetching him a single. Gets off the mark with this!
SARFRAZ AHMED is the new man.

OUT! Shafiq departs! Once again, immediately after the drinks break we see a wicket fall. Lapse in concentration maybe! Touch fullish around off, shapes away after pitching, Shafiq looks to defend it off the front foot but gets an outside edge. The ball flies low to third slip, where Khawaja once again takes a good low catch. Pakistan are falling apart as the Aussie pacers are striking gold here. However, Aslam is still out there on the other end. What will be going on in his mind, one must wonder!
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Angling into the hips, tucked in front of square leg. The short leg fielder chases it and keeps it down to three.
MITCHELL STARC to start off after the break!
Drinks time at the 'Gabba!
Full and angled in on off, Shafiq blocks that one with a straight bat.
Good length and angled in, Aslam drops it in front of cover to rush through for a quick single.
Back to short stuff for Aslam, he gets out of the line of the ball to leave it.
Aslam defends it in an unorthodox manner towards covers.
Angling into the body this time, Aslam gets in line of the ball to defend that well.
Good length outside off, left alone.
Angled into the pads, clipped towards fine leg for a couple.
ASAD SHAFIQ walks in at no. 6!

OUT! THE MAINSTAY HAS TO DEPART! Full and wide outside off, Misbah goes fetching for it and falls in the trap. The skipper goes to push it and the ball finds the outside edge which falls straight in the hands of Renshaw who bends low to catch it comfortably at first slip. Pakistan are in a bad shape now as they see their skipper go back to the pavilion.
Wayward stuff this time around. Short ball going down the leg side, Misbah lets that through to the keeper.
Outside off, Misbah leans forward to defend that ball really well.
Angling in from outside off, Misbah again gets in line of the ball to elegantly drive it straight down the ground which is well stopped by Bird.

Banged in short! Once again testing the opener with the short stuff! This time Aslam has his eyes on the ball and makes a watchful leave.
Ian Gould had a word with Hazlewood after the 4th delivery on his landing in the danger zone.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Hazlewood now comes from around the wicket to Aslam. He pitches it on length outside off, Aslam leaves it but the ball nips back in sharply, surprising the batsman. He has to be more careful out there.
Full outside off, pushed through covers for a single.

BEATEN! Full and wide outside off with a touch of outswing. Misbah too like Younis is looking to curb the swing by getting across and gets drawn into the stroke. He tries to push at it away from his body and almost pays price for it as the ball whizzes past the outside edge of his bat. Hazlewood is having a gala time out there under the lights.
Angles it down leg, Misbah gets across, looks to glance it but fails to make any contact. Wade behind stumps fails to grab the ball cleanly but does well to stop the ball.
This time he puts bat on ball and defends.

This is around middle and leg, defended watchfully.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Now Bird tests Aslam with a bouncer who ducks. He is gonna get a barricade of those the whole night.
That is a beauty. For the first time, Bird comes around the wicket. He bowls it in the corridor of uncertainty, making Aslam play forward and then deviates the ball away to beat the outside edge.
Works this wide of mid-wicket for a quick single. There was an excellent testing over from Hazlewood.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
There comes another bouncer, this time Aslam ducks in time.

ON THE HELMET AGAIN! Australia are not letting Sami have it easy here. This is another short ball and Aslam is not playing that length well. He just takes his eyes off the ball and ducks with his eyes closed. The ball rises, hits the helmet and lobs towards backward square leg. Umpire Ian Gould has a chat with Misbah, perhaps suggesting that Aslam could take a break. But the southpaw is confident that he can continue.
Pitched outside off, Sami gets in line of the ball to defend it.
Full outside off, Misbah drives it towards mid off showing the full face of the bat.
Pitched outside off, left alone again.
A bit short into the body, Misbah stands tall and gets hit on his top glove. The ball seems to be climbing on the batsmen.
Again outside off, Misbah lets that through.

Misbah gets in line of the delivery to push it towards mid off.

Aslam with a third leave in a row.

Hat-Trick ball. Straight to the stumps, the ball has taken an inside edge into his pads.
The skipper, MISBAH-UL-HAQ walks in to replace Younis. Hazlewood on a hat-trick! Here we go...

OUT! TWO IN TWO FOR JOSH! Younis goes for a golden duck. Full ball outside off and Younis Khan goes forward to defend it. The ball just moves away a touch and takes the outside edge straight to Wade. Big wicket for the Aussies as he can score some really big scores if he gets going. This wicket lands up Hazlewood with a chance of a Hat-Trick.

Pitched outside off, left alone.

Short and wide outside off, left alone by Aslam.

FOUR! GLORIOUS! Pitched up and outside off, Babar leans forward to get in line of the ball and drives it through covers for a boundary.
Azam gets in line of the ball to defend it. He calls for a single but is sent back.
Aslam stays in his crease to push it towards covers.

Players are back in the middle. SAMI ASLAM and BABAR AZAM walk out to the pitch as the lights are on. MITCHELL STARC will start the proceedings for the Aussies. Will he swing the session in his team's favour? Let's see...
...DAY 2, SESSION 3...

It took only one ball after drinks to dismiss Australia and have them bowl. Starc and Hazlewood got into their rhythm from the word go and started troubling the Pakistani openers with the pace, bounce and movement. They were soon rewarded with a big wicket of Azhar Ali. Nathan Lyon in the over before lunch got the ball to turn and that might have brought a smile to his face. Now, Babar Azam is out in the middle with Sami Aslam and will look to see off the rest of the day without any harm. Stay tuned for the last session of the day!

Australia would be the happier of the two sides going into the dinner break after posting a huge total of 429 and seeing the back of Azhar Ali after coming on to bowl. Pakistan started the session in a grand manner by sending back Hazlewood and the centurion, Handscomb in back-to-back deliveries. However, Lyon and Bird proved to be a thorn in their flesh as they added on 49 runs for the last wicket.
